gen-dafont-joystix-gf-arimo: Joystix spaces its arcade capitals wide and barely varies its stroke, like lightly flexed spring wire. Arimo follows with a tall, open plain sans body that would carry a long page without tiring.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-athiti: Athiti reads friendly and current, its single line width cut like vinyl with a see-through s. Joystix stamps bold, widely tracked arcade lettering over it, and the two stay clearly separate in voice while sharing a page.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Joystix brings widely tracked arcade lettering whose strokes barely differ in weight, tight between x-height and ascenders. Atkinson Hyperlegible is the one built for clarity.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters out like stencil bridges, with open counters and slightly clipped capitals. Joystix does best with bold, widely tracked arcade punch, while Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono does best at plain, steady legibility in sans-serif form.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-biryani: Biryani reads clean and approachable, with large-eyed e shapes. Joystix is best at loud, widely tracked arcade headlines whose joins taper only slightly, while Biryani is best at keeping a sans paragraph uniform and uncluttered.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-blinker: Chunky arcade swagger meets a blunt, marker-like round tip, with Joystix hairlines nearly as thick as its stems. Blinker's plain sans body keeps things readable.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-carrois-gothic: Joystix has understated thick-thin contrast and widely tracked, compact arcade letters that announce themselves at once. Carrois Gothic's sans-serif body sits beneath, modern and open.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Bold arcade lettering with a lightly shaded texture runs through every Joystix word, widely tracked and compact. Carrois Gothic SC's sans-serif curves stay open, which is its pull.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-chivo: Approachable describes Chivo, whose lowercase packs up toward the caps and shows daylight through every curve. Chivo's sans-serif clarity is the pair's strongest quality against Joystix's rounded, widely tracked arcade bulk.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-chocolate-classica: Joystix tracks its arcade letters wide with only a slight stroke difference. Chocolate Classical Sans follows in a sizable, broad-nibbed sans that never curls shut, so a long read stays easy.
